title: crataegus gracilior
intro: Crataegus gracilior, commonly known as Chinese hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is a deciduous shrub or small tree that has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Chinese hawthorn include cardiotonic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which can help to improve cardiovascular health, reduce blood pressure, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Chinese hawthorn include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
